turns.agent_input: A district sees chronic absenteeism rise at three middle schools. All three changed bus contractors, but two also shifted start times 35 minutes earlier. The third kept its start time yet still worsened, though less. Parent surveys mention both missed pickups and morning scheduling conflicts. Canceling the contractor mid-semester would be disruptive. What should the district infer and do?

observations: third did not shift and still worsened less
surveys mention pickup and schedule issues
not_observed: No additional facts beyond the prompt should be assumed.
discriminating_evidence: compare route-level missed pickups and absenteeism by school; targeted schedule/transport pilots
decision_critical_uncertainties: relative contribution of contractor reliability and start time
acceptable_interventions: targeted reversible fixes before district-wide contract termination
scoring_notes: The unchanged-start school provides partial evidence for a transport effect but not exclusivity.
